loc.Culture.description: The language texts are shown in, such as pl; empty shows them as written.

r.Probes.description: Lights the scene with its irradiance probes.

r.RayTracing.description: Traces shadows, ambient occlusion and live probes where the GPU has ray queries.

r.LiveProbes.description: Updates the irradiance probes with traced rays every frame (with ray tracing).

r.Upscaling.description: The game window's upscaling where the GPU has DLSS: Off, Quality (DLSS Quality) or Dlaa.

r.ViewportUpscaling.description: The editor viewport's upscaling where the GPU has DLSS: Off, Quality or Dlaa; read when the editor starts.

r.RayReconstruction.description: Denoises traced shadows and occlusion with DLSS Ray Reconstruction while DLSS upscales.

r.DepthFades.description: Draws the main camera's depth fade.

r.VSync.description: Waits for the display's refresh before showing each frame of the game window, capping the frame rate at it.

audio.Master.description: The volume of everything, from 0 to 1.

audio.Music.description: The volume of the music, from 0 to 1.

audio.Ambience.description: The volume of the ambience, from 0 to 1.

audio.Effects.description: The volume of the world's sounds, from 0 to 1.

audio.Dialogue.description: The volume of voices, from 0 to 1.

audio.Interface.description: The volume of the interface's sounds, from 0 to 1.
